content.title: Study at UTeM
content.content: Starting degree in Computer Engineering with Honours at Universiti Teknikal Malaysia Melaka

content.title: Dungeon Dive Card Game in C++ and SFML
content.content: Worked on an assignment involving data structure and algorithm. Created a simple graphical card game in C++. Used SFML as the framework for easy graphic coding

content.title: Portfolio Website
content.content: Made the website you're looking at right now! Developed with Bootstrap 5 and Webpack

content.title: 1st TU-UTeM VR Game Development Project
content.content: Joined a project involving Malaysian and Japanese students. Participants are required to create a VR game with the theme SDG. Learnt a lot about international collaboration (and the difficulty in communicating). Got experience on dealing with foreigners and touring for them during their visit

content.title: 2nd TU-UTeM VR Game Development Project
content.content: Joined the VR Game Project again, but as a participant and organisation member. Same concept; Participants are required to create a VR game with the theme SDG.

content.title: Snoezelen Room Integrated Design Project
content.content: Developed a mock of a snozelen room for personalized sensory therapy. The project involves sensors that detect the patient's condition and adjusts the room accordingly

content.title: Contributed to Classroom Monitoring Website
content.content: The website uses firebase for database

content.title: Internship at MF Ikhtiar Padu Sdn. Bhd.
content.content: Joined as an intern. Was mainly tasked in GiTN work such as server maintenance at government sites

content.title: Hybrid Iris Recognition Final Year Project
content.content: Developing a Hybrid Iris Recognition system that uses both fractal and texture feature of the iris
